raw.details:
Event Description

E-Cell is a student organization that organizes events like Meetups, tech talks, Hackathons, and aims to fill the gap between college and real industry, by providing an environment for students and people from all backgrounds to solve the real world problems

The event will bring together university students and working professionals to learn, collaborate and build practical AI projects during a one-day build sprint.

Event Details

  • Date: 27 October 2026
  • Time: 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM IST
  • Registration Start Date: 10 October 2026
  • Venue: IIMT University MEERUT
  • Format: Free, in-person Hack Day
  • Eligibility: University students and working professionals
  • Team Size: 2–4 members

Registration and Teams

  • Every participant must register individually through OrganizerHQ. Teams of 2–4 members are welcome.
  • For the online idea-submission round, teams should be pre-formed and one representative should submit the team's idea.
  • Registration does not guarantee an in-person seat. Shortlisted participants will receive a separate acceptance and RSVP email.

Important Dates

  • Registration: Individual registration through OrganizerHQ
  • Idea Submission Opens: 10 October 2026
  • Idea Submission Deadline: 20 October 2026 at 11:59 AM IST
  • Problem Statements Live : 10 October 2026
  • Event Date: 27 October 2026

What to Expect

  • Hacktoberfest and open-source AI orientation
  • Technical learning session
  • Team-based project building
  • Mentor support
  • Project submissions
  • Judging and finalist demos
  • Recognition and closing ceremony

Theme

Build with open-source AI and open-weight models.

Suggested areas include:

  • Open-source AI tools
  • Education
  • Accessibility
  • Healthcare
  • Sustainability
  • Civic impact
  • Indian languages
  • Culture and community solutions

What to Bring

  • Laptop and charger
  • Valid college or government-issued ID
  • Any developer accounts or tools needed for building

Important Information

  • Registration is individual.
  • Team idea submission is a separate process.
  • The idea-submission deadline is 20 October 2026 at 11:59 AM IST.

 

## Important Links

Join the Participant Community : https://chat.whatsapp.com/BUAe8kosLxg1Ol7M5bgXXF

Submit Round 1 – google form : https://forms.gle/zx19MF8VjaUCnNxB8

Problem Statement : https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-xxAlAUWx8fcTBPSxFuQquajSk0bqtpb/view?usp=sharing

PPT Template : https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/18uZBaJwz4RafsyiOTofyXdcKJnrleRXC/edit?slide=id.p1#slide=id.p1

View Guidelines : https://drive.google.com/file/d/1h2WrwfJ9eIIQzbOkLS9h5aRjyRxN0lJx/view?usp=sharing

Registration Video Guidelines : https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RUHMdLD9xnp99vJvkm2YOOoXhDoM4iHh/view?usp=sharing

 

  • Final seat confirmation will be sent separately by email.
